media.description: MAIN LOGO. A horizontal lockup on solid white. A mint-green outline tooth (#7EC9A2) runs into a threaded dental-implant root that tapers to a point. The mark sits between the words DENTAL and ARENA, set in slate-grey (#5A6765) Trajan-style serif capitals. Below is a full-width slate hairline rule, then 'CLINICA STOMATOLOGICA' in a widely spaced uppercase sans. The site uses it in the header and footer (3 times per page).
media.quality: Usable as-is on white or light backgrounds. It is the cleanest raster of the logo, with only light JPEG softness. The white background is not transparent and the file has 15px or less of padding. Best source for tracing an SVG; an SVG redraw is recommended for the new site.

media.description: The same full logo lockup (mint tooth/implant mark, DENTAL ARENA, rule, CLINICA STOMATOLOGICA) as a square PNG with a transparent background, exported from Canva. The logo fills about 1638x615 px in the middle of the canvas. Shown on the 15ani promo page.
media.quality: Needs cleanup. Background removal left white haze blobs along the baseline and under the letters, which show on any non-white background, and the letter edges are slightly wobbly. Trim the large empty margins. Use it only on white, or redraw the logo as SVG.

media.description: WordPress site icon (favicon or app icon) auto-cropped from the main logo. It shows the mint tooth/implant mark with the wordmark cut off at both sides ('AL ARE', 'ICA STOMATOLOGI').
media.quality: Unsuitable. The baked-in text is truncated. Build a new favicon from the tooth/implant mark alone, for example as an SVG on white or mint. Not referenced in the page text; it is the site icon.

He wears navy-blue V-neck scrubs and a wristwatch, with his hands in his pockets. Behind him are a blurred dark-grey wall, white pendant lights, a mustard armchair and a plant, the same studio session as the Fertea and Mașca photos. In the homepage team grid it appears directly before 'Dr. Andrei Marcoci – stomatologie generală'.

brand.typographyNotes:
COLOURS. All hex values were measured from pixel counts, not estimated. Brand mint, #7EC9A2 (rgb 126,201,162): the modal colour of the tooth/implant mark in both logo files (about 6,000 identical pixels), and the old site's flat mint banner is the same (#7BCAA0). It is too light for text on white (contrast about 1.9:1), so use it for the mark, fills, rings and backgrounds. For mint text or buttons, darken it to about #23774F (about 5.5:1 with white). Slate grey, #5A6765 (modal #596865 / #5B6765; whole-wordmark average #5B6664): a grey with a slight green-teal tint, used for the wordmark, rule and tagline; about 5.9:1 on white, so safe for body text. #1FB27C is the more saturated green of the physical facade sign in Luduș (DSC1557) and is a signage variant, not the primary colour. The logo sits on white. Supporting interior colours from the photos: mustard yellow sofas, dark-grey walls, striped grey and cream wallpaper, preserved-moss greens. The 15-years promo red #BE0704 and gold are campaign colours, not brand colours.

WORDMARK TYPEFACE. 'DENTAL ARENA' is set in a classical Roman inscriptional serif in the style of Trajan: all capitals, wedge serifs, moderate stroke contrast, an R with a long sweeping leg, pointed A apexes, and no lowercase. The capitals come in two sizes. The D of DENTAL and the final A of ARENA are full height, and ENTAL and AREN are small caps, so the two words read as a symmetrical pair of bookends. The mint tooth/implant mark stands between the two words, and its threaded root tapers to a point on the baseline, almost like a V joining them. A thin slate hairline runs the full width beneath. The tagline 'CLINICA STOMATOLOGICA' sits below in a light humanist sans in the style of Gill Sans, uppercase with very wide tracking (about 0.3em), centred, in the same slate. The artwork has no diacritics; the correct Romanian is 'CLINICĂ STOMATOLOGICĂ', but keep the logo artwork unchanged. Close web-font matches: Cinzel (Google Fonts), or Trajan Pro if licensed, for display headings that echo the wordmark; Cabin, whose design draws on Johnston and Gill, for a sans that echoes the tagline. Both support Romanian ă â î ș ț.

LOGO ASSETS. The cleanest raster is the 1845x645 JPG on white. The 1916x1916 transparent PNG has white halo artefacts from background removal, and the 512x512 site icon is a bad crop with cut-off text. Recommendation: redraw the logo as an SVG (full lockup, mark only, and a white-on-mint or white-on-slate variant) and make a new favicon from the mark alone.

TEAM MAPPING. From the homepage team-grid order, where the image comes right before each name: Dr. Andrei Marcoci = 312167804_…jpg; Dr. Mihail Dan Mașca = Untitled-design-2024-05-27T102139.723.png; Dr. Paul Bologa = 328740551_…jpg; Dr. Podar Victoria-Ana has NO portrait (the site uses the implant stock image T130321 as a placeholder); Dr. Fertea Ana-Maria = 431150871_…jpg. The genders in the photos match the names. The facade locations (dusk white house = Cristești, silver street facade = Luduș) are inferred, not confirmed by the page text.
